summary: Completed the final QuickBooks Online integration todo (qbo-test-rollout): full test coverage added and passing. New test files: __tests__/quickbooks/snapshots.integration.test.js (fixture invoices inserted in a rolled-back transaction; covers web/onsite/wholesale channel journals, EBT splits, forgiven fees, membership fees/refunds, zero-value cycles, producer bills with fee credits, daily payment batching and cutover suppression), posting.integration.test.js (mocks src/QuickBooks/OAuth.js with a scripted fake Intuit transport via bun mock.module; runs real Client.js/Post.js/Worker.js against dev MySQL; covers end-to-end cycle posting, FIFO payouts, requestid reuse, 429/500 backoff, 401 refresh-retry, validation blocking, ambiguous-timeout adoption by DocNumber, checksum drift blocking), and bootstrap.integration.test.js (dry-run, clean create, idempotent rerun, adoption, conflicting account type abort, realm/environment mismatch). Fixed a real bug found by tests: wClaim_SyncJobs in src/QuickBooks/Db.js used NOW() while the mysql2 pool writes datetimes as UTC (timezone 'Z'); switched to UTC_TIMESTAMP() for WhenNextRetry/WhenLeaseExpires comparisons and lease assignment. Fixed test flake from DATETIME whole-second rounding on lease expiry. Ran eslint --fix on all QuickBooks files; package.json test script changed from jest to 'bun test'. Full suite: 72 pass, 0 fail across 8 files, stable over 8 consecutive runs.
pending_tasks: Human-only rollout steps remain: connect an Intuit sandbox realm (real client ID/secret in Cfg.js), run bun run quickbooks:bootstrap --dry-run then real, post one representative cycle, compare QBO trial balance to shopeatlocal, test partial payout + reversal, accountant sign-off; then production: deploy with quickbooksOnline prod flag off, configure prod credentials/redirect URI, select future cutover cycle, bootstrap, enable posting, monitor first cycle.
decisions: Goal: test Worker/Post/Client against realistic transport. Decision: mock only src/QuickBooks/OAuth.js (OAuthClientNew returns fake makeApiCall; wFreshConnection reads real DB connection row), keeping Client.js requestid/401-retry/query logic real. Why: plan requires mocking the local adapter, not intuit-oauth internals; bun mock.module cannot access the unmocked original module. Invalidates-if: OAuth.js export surface changes. | Goal: reliable job claiming. Decision: use UTC_TIMESTAMP() instead of NOW() in wClaim_SyncJobs. Why: mysql2 pool timezone is 'Z' so JS Dates persist as UTC, but dev MySQL server runs local time (UTC+2), making backoff/lease comparisons wrong by 2h. Invalidates-if: pool timezone config changes. | Goal: deterministic reruns of committed-fixture tests. Decision: posting tests purge by deterministic SourceKeys and Note marker 'qbtest-post' both before setup and after; QuickBooksEvent rows must be deleted before jobs (FK).
